end.summary:
Practised identifying cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Used features such as flat faces, corners and round surfaces.
Aditya identified wheels as round and named a ball as a sphere, explaining that it has no corners.
Aditya continued to treat every box as a cube; this was not corrected by the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised shape names through familiar objects and encouraged checking features such as faces and corners. Aditya explained that a ball is a sphere because it is round and has no corners. They continued to mix up cubes and cuboids, so this was not corrected during the lesson. At home, compare a small cube and a rectangular box and check whether all faces are equal squares.
